source.publication: 2025 IT-540 Louisiana Resident Income Tax Return Instructions (Revised 7-26)
source.section: instructions PDF page 7, code 04E; FAQ page 1, Federal Retirement Benefits Exclusion (R.S. 47:44.2); Schedule E Lines 1, 3, 4A to 4H, 5 (Form IT-540 PDF page 8; instructions PDF pages 6, 7 and 10); Form IT-540 (PDF page 3) Lines 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13; instructions PDF page 3, Lines 7 to 13; rate: PDF page 1 What's New

worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 33,000.00 + military retired pay (person 0) 36,000.00 = 69,000.00. Federal taxable income = 69,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 53,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Filing status 1 on Form IT-540. Louisiana starts from federal AGI. Schedule E: Line 1 federal AGI 69,000.00. Line 3 total = 69,000.00. Exempt income: code 04E military retired pay 36,000.00. Line 4H = 36,000.00. Line 5 Louisiana AGI = 69,000.00 - 36,000.00 = 33,000.00. IT-540 Line 7 (from Schedule E Line 5) 33,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction (filing status 1) 12,500.00. Lines 9A to 9D skipped (no federal itemizing). Line 10 = 33,000.00 - 12,500.00 = 20,500.00. Line 11 = 20,500.00 x .03 = 615.00. Line 12 credits 0.00. Line 13 = 615.00. The FAQ page's 'federal retirees, both military and nonmilitary' is the source for military retired pay.
